result.topic_en: Notes on Riemann's P-function (hypergeometric functions): integrals of the form $\int (z-a)^\alpha(z-b)^\beta(z-c)^\gamma(z-d)^\delta\,dz$ as solutions of the differential equation, their linear relations, and transformation formulas between P-functions with permuted exponents and arguments $x$, $1-x$, $x/(x-1)$.
